messages:
maria: Quick sync: I put together an orchestration playbook for onboarding a tenant-local control plane (CP) into their VPC with zero-customer-downtime. want quick eyes before I create the RFC follow-up.
ash: drop the playbook, will skim. main concern is rollback speed and how we handle DNS flip. :eyes: 
maria: TL;DR phases: 1) bootstrap resources (k8s, local secrets, CSR exchange) but keep central CP handling traffic. 2) establish read shadowing via proxy and validate consistency. 3) enable non-blocking writes to local CP (idempotent-only) and run reconciliation jobs. 4) canary writes (1% -> 10% -> 50%) with automated rollback if SLOs degrade. 5) full cutover and central deprecation for that tenant.
kevin: For bootstrap keying, I prefer customer KMS CSR flow: agent generates keypair locally, posts CSR to signing service over a pre-provisioned one-time token exchanged over peering/privatelink. no private key leaves customer infra.
zoe: agree. make token single-use and short TTL. Also record CSR request in central audit stream (metadata only: tenant id, bootstrap id, timestamp).
ash: about connectivity patterns: PrivateLink solves SNAT & egress accounting but adds per-tenant endpoint mgmt. Peering is cheaper at scale but we hit route table limits. Proposal: classify tenants into tiers and default to peering for dev/smaller tenants and PrivateLink for regulated/enterprise.
maria: will add that tiered decision table. also need to include egress cost guardrails in the playbook (alerts if egress > expected threshold during validation).
kevin: telemetry: avoid shipping raw traces centrally. send metrics aggregates and sampling pointers; keep full traces in tenant logs with optional forward. make sure PII sanitation happens before any cross-VPC forwarding.
zoe: add a probe that checks KV cache warmup, routing table diff, and model pin reconciliation. we had a case where model pin mismatch caused silent routing to default model.
ash: can we use an event-sourced stream for catalog replication? central publishes events, tenant CP consumes and materializes read-only views. that minimizes write surface and keeps global truths central.
maria: yes. concerns: stream requires cross-VPC egress. include fallback: if stream lag > X seconds, route-control calls back to central for consistency. add circuit-breaker.
kevin: quota enforcement: central currently enforces rate limits. For local CP we must sync quotas at bootstrap and maintain a small local cache with TTL and reconciliation. if cache misses and central is unreachable fall back to permissive with throttling until reconciliation, or conservative deny? ops decision needed.
ash: safer to fail closed (deny) for control-plane modifications, but that could block customers. propose config flag per-tenant: permissive or strict. default strict for enterprise.
maria: gating metrics for canaries: 95th latency < 1.1x central baseline, error rate delta < 0.5%, successful reconciliation runs > 99% in 24h. if any fail, auto-rollback.
zoe: include billing check step after each ramp: validate request counts and cost counters. we once accidentally doubled egress billing.
nash: ops runbook checklist: pre-create rollback cluster, automated route unbind, verify cert rotation job, run synthetic requests for 30m before canary, monitor alert burn-in for 2h after ramp.
ops-bot: deploy:local-cp-bootstrap queued for tenant gamma-57 at 3419876688 by maria
maria: bootstrap snippet (CSR exchange): ```bash
# agent generates key and CSR locally
openssl req -new -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout privkey.pem -out csr.pem -subj "/CN=tenant-gamma-57-tenant-cp"
# exchange CSR over privatelink/peering with one-time token
curl -sS -X POST "https://bootstrap.internal/v1/sign" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONE_TIME_TOKEN" --data-binary @csr.pem > signed.crt
kubectl create secret tls tenant-cp-cert --cert=signed.crt --key=privkey.pem
```
kevin: include a TTL-rotation job for that secret and KMS audit forwarding (metadata only).
maria: good. i'll update the doc with diagrams for control flows (privatelink vs peering), the tier decision matrix, and the phased runbook + gating thresholds. posting PR this afternoon — comments appreciated. :thumbsup:
